name: Money
title: Currencies and exchange rates
description: Enable currencies and exchange rates for monetary records and aggregates.

enabled.title: Enabled currencies
enabled.description: The base currency is {{base}} and is always enabled. Monetary records can use the enabled currencies.

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.description: How much 1 unit of the currency is worth in {{base}}. The most recent current rate applies.
rates.dialogDescription: The rate applies from the given date.
rates.rateHint: A number greater than zero with up to 10 decimal places.
rates.invalidRate: Enter a number greater than zero with up to 10 decimal places.
rates.deleteDescription: Active monetary records use the previous effective rate, when available.
rates.emptyHint: Record the rate of the enabled currencies to convert amounts.
rates.emptyNoCurrencies: Enable a currency besides the base one to record rates.
rates.note: The owner of each record type decides when to recalculate values or keep the closing rate.

errors.currency_not_enabled: The currency is not enabled for the organization.
errors.exchange_rate_exists: The currency already has a rate on this date.
errors.exchange_rate_not_found: The exchange rate no longer exists.
errors.version_conflict: Someone else changed the rate. Reload and try again.
errors.exchange_rate_provider_not_configured: Choose a rate source before updating.
errors.exchange_rate_provider_unavailable: The rate provider did not answer. Try again later.
errors.generic: The operation could not be completed.

provider.title: Automatic update
provider.description: Fetch the rates of the enabled currencies every day from a public source, without an access key. Rates entered by hand on the same date are kept.
provider.label: Rate source
provider.urlHint: Optional. Empty uses https://api.frankfurter.app; enter the address of a self-hosted Frankfurter instance.
provider.syncFailed: No rate from the provider for: {{currencies}}
